Markets.title: Shiprocket shares make strong debut: Stock lists at 35% premium over IPO price at Rs 131
Markets.summary: Shiprocket shares made a strong market debut by listing at Rs 131. This price represents a 35% premium over its initial public offering price.

Markets.title: Rupee hits three-week low, traders wary about fall to 96/USD as RBI stands guard
Markets.summary: The Indian rupee fell to a three-week low on Wednesday due to high oil prices and strong demand for the dollar. Interventions by the Reserve Bank of India helped limit the currency's decline as traders awaited upcoming policy review minutes.

Markets.title: Oil India vs ONGC vs OMCs: What JM Financial’s $80 Brent call means for oil stocks
Markets.summary: JM Financial predicts Brent crude will remain near eighty dollars a barrel for the next year. This forecast leads analysts to favor upstream producers Oil India and ONGC while warning that lower margins pressure oil marketing companies like HPCL, BPCL, and IOCL.

Markets.title: Why rising Treasury yields are becoming a growing risk for the US economy
Markets.summary: A sell-off in U.S. Treasuries has driven yields higher, increasing borrowing costs for households, corporations, and the federal government. This rise in yields threatens to pressure mortgages, corporate investment, asset values, and government debt servicing.

Markets.title: South Korea’s SK Hynix announces buyback after stock crashes 50% in two months, wipes off massive retail wealth
Markets.summary: SK Hynix announced a record 40 trillion won share buyback and cancellation after its stock plunged nearly 50%. The move follows a broader market downturn in South Korea's Kospi driven by chipmaker concentration, leveraged ETF risks, and rising bond yields.

Markets.title: Global Market: European shares flat as Middle East risks weigh; Fed Minutes in focus
Markets.summary: European shares remained flat due to Middle East tensions and caution ahead of the Federal Reserve's meeting minutes. Gains in basic resources offset technology losses, while accelerated UK inflation added uncertainty to the interest rate outlook.

Geo-Political.title: Sacked Ukrainian defence minister calls for presidential election
Geo-Political.summary: Ukraine has suspended elections under martial law, which has been in effect since February 2022. Despite this suspension, the recently dismissed Ukrainian defense minister is now calling for a presidential election.

Geo-Political.title: Mushroom murderer trial undermined by 'catastrophic' hotel mix-up, appeal court told
Geo-Political.summary: Erin Patterson's lawyers are appealing her murder conviction for killing three relatives with toxic mushrooms. The defense argues that a "catastrophic" hotel mix-up by authorities severely compromised the trial.

Geo-Political.title: Trump pauses new tariffs on Canada for three days, saying deal close
Geo-Political.summary: US President Donald Trump paused new tariffs on Canadian goods for three days. He stated that both sides are currently finalizing documents to avert the import taxes.

Geo-Political.title: South Korea shortens war games with US, citing Washington request
Geo-Political.summary: South Korea has shortened its joint military exercises with the United States. The decision follows President Trump's announcement to curtail these drills due to his favorable relationship with North Korean leader Kim Jong Un.

Geo-Political.title: Apparent human remains found in US reservoir as water levels hit record low
Geo-Political.summary: Human skeletal remains, including a jaw with teeth, were discovered in Lake Mead. The find occurred as water levels in the United States reservoir dropped to record lows.

Geo-Political.title: Meta hooked children on Facebook and Instagram, US court hears
Geo-Political.summary: A US court trial began regarding a major lawsuit brought by US states against Meta. Meta argued that social media addiction does not exist, while the states claimed the company hooked children on Facebook and Instagram.

AI & Tech.summary: An online course creator recently discovered their WordPress SaaS course was recommended as the top result by ChatGPT. This occurred without the use of paid advertising or traditional search engine optimization strategies.

AI & Tech.summary: LimeWire is a generative AI platform that enables users to create various types of AI content. Additionally, the platform provides creators with specific tools to share and monetize their digital creations.

Data & Insights.title: Who pays, who profits — Unpacking the economics of India's toll landscape, in charts
Data & Insights.summary: Data from the IHMCL shows how high-traffic routes, changing private involvement, and FASTag annual passes shape India's highway revenue. These factors together drive the economics of the country's toll landscape and determine who pays and profits.

Data & Insights.title: Ind-Ra raises India’s FY27 GDP growth estimate to 6.8%
Data & Insights.summary: India Ratings and Research (Ind-Ra) has increased India's fiscal year 2027 GDP growth forecast to 6.8%. However, the agency warns that the West Asia conflict, persistent inflation, a weakening currency, and sluggish capital expenditure continue to pose downside risks.

Data & Insights.title: Govt frontloads farm spending as El Nino risks cloud rural outlook
Data & Insights.summary: The Indian government is accelerating agricultural spending and fertilizer subsidies to protect rural incomes. This strategy aims to counteract the negative economic impacts of El Nino and a weak monsoon on the rural economy.

Data & Insights.title: $57 billion pours in, another $30 billion may follow: Indian economy eyes massive $50 billion surplus
Data & Insights.summary: SBI Research predicts India will achieve a $50 billion balance of payments surplus for fiscal year 2027. This projected surplus is driven by strong foreign currency inflows.

Data & Insights.title: Patchy progress, masked extremes: how the Southwest Monsoon has played out so far
Data & Insights.summary: Although the overall rainfall deficit for the Southwest Monsoon has narrowed to 13%, the weather has been extremely erratic. This unpredictable pattern of heavy downpours and long dry spells has created severe regional imbalances across the country.

Data & Insights.title: Govt weighs scrapping performance bank guarantees for MSME contracts
Data & Insights.summary: The Indian government is considering the elimination of performance bank guarantees for Micro, Small, and Medium Enterprises (MSMEs) securing government contracts. Currently, MSMEs awarded orders exceeding ₹100,000 must provide a bank guarantee worth 3% to 10% of the project's value.

India.title: "Don't Think We Should Encourage Large Families": Congress MP On Vijay Government's Move
India.summary: Congress MP Karti Chidambaram disagreed with the Tamil Nadu government's policy to encourage large families. He made the statement after the state extended maternity leave to 365 days for women having their third child.

India.title: Kerala Teen Plots Grandfather's Murder, Watches Him Suffocate On Video Call
India.summary: A teenage girl in Kerala directed four other teenagers to break into her grandfather's house and murder him. She watched the brutal attack and his suffocation in real time over a video call.

India.title: Detergent In Place Of Salt In Mid-Day Meal, 36 Students Fall Ill At Bihar School
India.summary: Thirty-six students in Bihar fell ill after eating a mid-day meal prepared with detergent instead of salt. The cook accidentally mistook the detergent powder for salt because both containers were stored together in the kitchen.

India.title: Mayawati's Brahmin Bet: Bid To Revive 2007 Coalition In 2027 UP Polls
India.summary: Bahujan Samaj Party chief Mayawati has appointed Satish Chandra Mishra to lead election-related responsibilities for the party. This move is part of an outreach effort toward the Brahmin community ahead of the 2027 Uttar Pradesh assembly elections.

India.title: AICTE Revises 2026-27 Calendar, Check Key Dates For Classes, Admissions
India.summary: AICTE has revised its academic calendar for the 2026-27 session, updating key dates for admissions and classes. Additionally, the council provides scholarships for GATE- and CEED-qualified students enrolled in postgraduate engineering, technology, and design programs at approved institutions.

India.title: Tejashwi Yadav Detained During Protest Against Cop Using AK-47, Water Cannons Used
India.summary: Tejashwi Yadav was detained during a protest against the Bihar government over police firing an AK-47 during a student demonstration last month. Authorities used water cannons to disperse the crowd during the demonstration.

General.title: Jump in energy bills drives UK inflation to highest rate for four months
General.summary: UK inflation rose to a four-month high due to an increase in energy bills. Chancellor John Healey stated that the ongoing war in Iran continues to impact domestic prices.

General.title: Thunderstorm warnings issued for parts of UK with flash flooding expected
General.summary: Thunderstorm warnings have been issued for northern England, eastern Scotland, and Northern Ireland starting Wednesday. The storms are expected to bring flash flooding to these regions.

General.title: Burnham unveils plan to get rough sleepers off streets for Christmas
General.summary: Andy Burnham has announced a plan to offer housing to all rough sleepers in England by Christmas. This initiative is modeled after the successful "Everyone In" program from the COVID-19 pandemic.

General.title: Tennis player Nick Kyrgios suspended after testing positive for cocaine
General.summary: Tennis player Nick Kyrgios has received a provisional suspension from the sport. The suspension was issued after he tested positive for cocaine.

General.title: French civil servant drugged us to make us urinate on ourselves, say accusers
General.summary: More than 200 women accuse Christian Nègre of drugging them to make them urinate - two share their stories.

General.title: Scientists 'stunned' by children's lung recovery in ultra low emission zone
General.summary: A study shows children's lung capacity caught up with peers in less polluted areas after a clean air zone was introduced. Scientists were stunned by the speed of this lung recovery.
